title: NEDE piecewise background conservation and matching
faithful_claim: NEDE is modeled as an instantaneous false-vacuum-to-fluid transition with conserved background density and trigger-defined perturbations.

equations.expression: rho_N(a)=rho_* for a<a_*; rho_N(a)=rho_* (a_*/a)^{3(1+w*)} for a>a_*
equations.definitions: a* instantaneous transition scale; rho* density at transition; w*=2/3 is the paper's fixed fit choice.
equations.domain: Instantaneous effective-fluid background, no trigger/perturbation/microphysical qualification.

equations.locator: Eqs. (6)-(7), PDF p.3; rewritten with explicit after-minus-before convention
equations.definitions: Dot means cosmic-time t derivative; source jump convention is before minus after; natural units require conversion.
equations.domain: Paper pressure-jump matching in GR at fixed transition density.

assumptions: Tunneling psi field, subdominant ultralight phi trigger; fast percolation.
Post-collision energy approximated as constant-w fluid; w*=2/3 chosen for fit.
Synchronous gauge; cosmic-time convention; cs²=w* closes fluid equations.

minimal_test.question: Piecewise background conservation, matching and fixed-endpoint ruler response for the paper effective fluid.
observables: r_s relative to zero-NEDE matched control
minimal_test.scope: Explicit a_*, f_*, w*=2/3 for paper branch, H0/densities/closure/units and acoustic endpoint; proposed a_* is a phenomenological input unless the trigger is implemented. All choices remain to be registered; no inferred values are inserted into a runnable request.

simplifications: Tunneling/percolation, bubble-wall collisions, microphysical realization of w*.
Trigger evolution and spatial decay-time perturbations with Eq.(14).
Observable CMB/LSS/GW prediction; the background is not the full NEDE model.
data_dependencies: Planck 2018 TT, TE, EE and lensing likelihood with nuisance parameters (authors cite Planck likelihood reference [72]).
SH0ES H0=74.03±1.42 km s^-1 Mpc^-1 measurement (Riess et al. 2019 reference [2]).
BOSS DR12 anisotropic BAO and growth at z=0.38, 0.51, 0.61; 6dF isotropic BAO at z=0.106; SDSS DR7 main-galaxy BAO at z=0.15 (references [69]–[71]).
Primordial helium abundance constraint used as BBN likelihood (reference [73]).
CLASS adapted for NEDE and MontePython parameter sampling; neutrinos modeled as two massless plus one massive species with Mν=0.06 eV.
No likelihood file hashes or machine-readable chains are supplied in the admitted paper text; lineage beyond cited dataset/release descriptions is unknown here.
unknowns: Bubble-collision coarse-graining and finite transition corrections.
Transition hypersurface robustness and possible residual trigger dust.
Reference implementation outputs, unfixed-parameter priors and shared-data covariance.
verification_gates: Keep numerical verification, observation lineage, inference validation and scientific interpretation as separate gates.
Freeze reference cases and consumer-derived error allocations before accepting outputs; no production tolerance is invented here.
Historical fit values are comparison targets only after matching release, likelihood, priors and implementation.
Declare before-minus-after source jump convention and cosmic time; split quadrature at a_* rather than smoothing silently.
Check f_*→0 and density/H matching; independently verify Raychaudhuri derivative.
Before calling it trigger-consistent implement phi evolution and verify H(z*)=0.2m with physical unit conversions.
Perturbation extension must satisfy synchronous junction Eqs.(12),(14), closure cs²=w* and both super/sub-horizon cases.
falsification: Density/H discontinuity or reversed Hdot jump falsifies this matched-fluid implementation. Background agreement cannot validate the microscopic constant-w conversion, or its predicted GW spectrum.

consumer.capability_status: No compiled EDE, NEDE or timescape model at inspected revision; all listed scientific capabilities unqualified.

blockers: No compiled piecewise NEDE density, trigger or transition matching model.
Existing sound-horizon operation cannot receive this expansion; no CMB/LSS/GW likelihood support or recipe runner.

qualification.reason: Source/design review only. No compiled model, admitted data, numerical run or paper reproduction.
